answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. Every claim climbs the ivory of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the plume re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the hollow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
